correctness.rationale: The proof separates boundary failure, finite exhaustive support ranges, adjacent primorial strata, and an analytic tail. The inspected verifier enumerates 2,202 admissible level-7 values and 19,710 level-8 values, with strictly positive explicit-bound margins. The boundary factorizations and totients agree with the theorem, and the monotone tail quotient closes every larger integer. This proves exactly \(N_7=M_6=290239045397854538365381\) and \(N_8=M_7=4015602312602016465554214991\), not the all-level conjecture.
residual_risks: The finite certificate checks the stated reduced ranges; its mathematical force depends on the separately reconstructed support-reduction lemmas and explicit prime-counting bounds.
